# Lighting and Bulb Swaps

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Cut a lip around the reverse light socket to accommodate a larger 7443 dual-filament bulb. [t904]

## Tools

- Dremel tool [t904]
- Microfiber cloth [t904]
- [Partial] Soldering iron [t904]

## Parts

- 7443 dual-filament bulb, switchback [t904]
- 7443 socket with two filaments [t904]

## Tips & gotchas

- Use a microfiber cloth inside the housing to prevent black plastic shavings from falling into the light assembly. [t904]
- Ensure enough plastic remains on the new 7443 socket for the clips to bind securely and seal against moisture. [t904]

## Common mistakes

- Removing an entire harness section which can leave bulb holes empty, causing debris or flecks to get trapped inside the housing. [t904]
